title: Dynamic Important Example Mining for Reinforcement Finetuning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used to strengthen the reasoning abilities of large models, yet its effectiveness is bound by how training data are selected and used. Most data-centric RFT methods rely on static or heuristic sample selection, implicitly assuming a sample's value is fixed over training. This overlooks the non-stationary dynamics of policy learning and can lead to suboptimal updates. We propose Dynamic Important Example Mining (DIEM), a principled and fully automated framework that makes data utilization adaptive throughout RFT. DIEM integrates two components into each optimization step: (i) a gradient-alignment importance estimator that efficiently approximates each sample's marginal contribution to policy improvement; and (ii) a constrained batch reweighting scheme that maximizes aggregate utility while preserving the update's gradient magnitude to stabilize optimization. translated_title: 强化微调中的动态重要样本挖掘
translated_abstract: 强化微调（RFT）被越来越多地用于增强大模型的推理能力，但其有效性受限于训练数据的选择和使用方式。大多数以数据为中心的RFT方法依赖静态或启发式的样本选择，隐含地假设样本的价值在训练过程中是固定不变的。这忽略了策略学习的非平稳动态特性，可能导致次优的模型更新。我们提出了动态重要样本挖掘（DIEM），这是一个有原则且完全自动化的框架，使数据利用在整个RFT过程中具备自适应性。DIEM在每个优化步骤中集成了两个组件：（i）一个基于梯度对齐的重要性估计器，能够高效近似每个样本对策略提升的边际贡献；（ii）一个受约束的批重加权方案，在保持更新梯度幅值以稳定优化的同时最大化整体效用。在多个推理基准测试上（摘要截断）。
tldr: 提出动态重要样本挖掘（DIEM）框架，通过梯度对齐的重要性估计与受约束的批重加权，使强化微调中的样本选择随训练进程动态自适应，从而更高效地提升大模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes DIEM, a fully automated framework that dynamically mines and reweights important training examples during reinforcement fine-tuning via gradient-alignment importance estimation, enabling adaptive data utilization and better reasoning performance.
